name: app.filmagic/filmagic
title: Filmagic
description: Make launch videos and social posts from any website. Returns a link that builds it in your brand.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List Filmagic video and social post templates with what each is for, its category and lengths. Filter by category (Launch, Posts, Story, Product, Mockup, Demo, Social) or a search word.

category.description: Launch, Posts, Story, Product, Mockup, Demo or Social

query.description: A word to match in the name or use, e.g. "AI", "app", "carousel"

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Start a Filmagic video from a product website. Returns a filmagic.app link: opening it reads the site and builds the video in the browser, ready to preview, edit and export. Without a template, Filmagic writes a custom cut for the product; with one, it fills that template.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Filmagic plans and what each includes: the free plan, the one-video pass and the monthly plans, with credits and export quality.
